from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class LM83_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            # Initialize all registers to their reset values
            0x00: 0x00,  # TEMP_LOCAL
            0x01: 0x00,  # TEMP_D2
            0x02: 0x00,  # SR1
            0x03: 0x00,  # CONFIG
            0x05: 0x7F,  # LHS
            0x07: 0x7F,  # D2RHS
            0x09: 0x00,  # CONFIG write_addr
            0x0B: 0x00,  # LHS write_addr
            0x0D: 0x00,  # D2RHS write_addr
            0x2C: 0x00,  # MID
            0x30: 0x00,  # TEMP_D1
            0x31: 0x00,  # TEMP_D3
            0x35: 0x00,  # SR2
            0x38: 0x7F,  # D1RHS
            0x3A: 0x7F,  # D3RHS
            0x42: 0x7F,  # TCS
            0x50: 0x00,  # D1RHS write_addr
            0x52: 0x00,  # D3RHS write_addr
            0x5A: 0x00,  # TCS write_addr
            0xFE: 0x01,  # MID
            0xFF: 0x00   # STEP_ID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        else:
            return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr == 0x09 or addr == 0x0B or addr == 0x0D or addr == 0x50 or addr == 0x52 or addr == 0x5A:
            # CONFIG, LHS, D2RHS, D1RHS, D3RHS, TCS registers have read_addr and write_addr
            addr = addr & 0xFFFE

        if nbytes == 1:
            # Update only bits 15:8
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | ((data & 0xFF) << 8)
        else:
            self.regs[addr] = data
